snippet.title: Spin Tactics: Build the Engine, Not the Luck | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Spin Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilder. You build an engine of Companions and
Gems that turns a random board into a machine that pays out every round.

There is no real money, no wagering and no microtransactions. It is a single
player strategy game with a spinning board.

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856990/Spin_Tactics/

Live symbols score the moment they land. Combos score when the round ends, from
SMALL all the way up to GALACTIC. Every round gives you limited Actions, and
spinning or swapping each costs one, so an areak the
combo you spent the round building.

EVERY TURN IS A DECISION
Spin, swap, or keep what you have. Actions are the real currency.

NO TWO ENGINES ALIKE
Equip Companions across eight active slots and four in reserve, where the order
you place them changes what they score. Socket Gems to recolour symbols, retime
them, clone them, or open new slots. Feed anything you do not want to the Black
Hole.

PUSH IT UNTIL IT BREAKS
Beat the bosses and their Score Drain, then climb Ascension for as long as your
engine holds together. Online leaderboards.

Runs last 30 to 60 minutes, with progression that carries between them.

#roguelike #deckbuilder #indiegame
